title: On Generalised Discrete Torsion
summary: For a 2d gauged sigma model with target space $M$ and discrete gauge group $G$, we consider a generalisation of Vafa's discrete torsion $H^2(BG; U(1))$ that assigns different local discrete torsion phases to different singular loci of the orbifold $M/G$. Our generalised discrete torsion lives in $H^2_G(M; U(1))$, and gives a consistent implementation of Gaberdiel and Kaste's prescription for inserting such local discrete torsion phases by hand at higher genus.
